biggest_catch: Granny doesn't buy your card — it's a comparison tool. The actual sale (and its fees/timing) happens on the partner site you click through to.
catches: Granny itself never buys cards; every 'offer' shown is a partner's quote you must complete on that partner's site.
Comparison quotes can be stale or inaccurate (one reviewer found a listed offer invalid at click-through) — always confirm the live offer on the partner site.
You ultimately sell at 70-90% of balance; Granny just helps you find the top of that range.
Selling still requires handing card details to a third-party partner — Granny doesn't change partner risk.
No payout from Granny directly; timing/fees are set by whichever partner you choose.

maximize: Run every card through Granny's comparison before going direct — it's built to rank CardCash, GiftCash, Raise and others by what they'll actually pay for your exact brand, which beats checking sites one by one. For repeat cards, pair this with Granny's deal alerts so you sell when your brand's demand (and offers) peak.

steps: Go to giftcardgranny.com and enter your card's brand and remaining balance
Compare the ranked cash offers from partner buyers (CardCash, GiftCash, Raise, Gameflip, etc.)
Click through to the highest-offer partner
Complete the sale on the partner's site under its terms and receive payout
timing: Comparison is instant; actual payout timing/fees set by the partner you sell through (typically a few business days)
who_pays: Granny itself never pays you — the partner exchange you choose from its comparison pays you directly.
who_qualifies: Anyone with an unwanted gift card can compare offers; the actual sale completes on the chosen partner's site under that partner's eligibility rules.
work_available: GiftCardGranny's comparison service is active — but it's a directory, not a buyer; every 'offer' shown must be completed on a partner site.
what_gets_accepted: Acceptance is set by whichever partner you sell through — their balance-verification and brand rules apply, not Granny's.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Comparing is free; partner fees are disclosed on partner sites. Unpaid time goes to comparison and completing the sale on the partner's site.
